entities.summary: Hasanboy Marfjon Ugli Dusmatov is an Uzbek professional boxer. One of the most decorated amateur fighters of his generation, Dusmatov is a two time Olympic and World Championships gold medalist and three time Asian Championships gold medalist. Coached by Ziyatdinbek Toygonbaev.
